entries.topic: Prepare D171 three-device automated network diagnostics with PDA fixed on normal network
facts: Owner requests isolated connectivity test using two authenticated Windows Agent diagnostic clients, each under a distinct authorized Agent account, and one authenticated Android PDA Picker diagnostic client under a dedicated test Picker account; actual login identifiers and passwords are not stored in public GitHub.

All three test clients log in, each presses one Start Test action; the suite must wait for all three authenticated participants to be READY, assign and clearly display Agent A, Agent B, PDA and role, then coordinate scenarios from one shared session.

PDA remains on ordinary Internet network throughout. Only Agent A/B change between NORMAL and OFFICE; each EXE must show the exact participant, required next network and a gated 'network changed' confirmation, preferably verifying observable network interface/proxy path instead of trusting a label.

Proposed scenario stages: A/B NORMAL/NORMAL baseline, OFFICE/NORMAL, NORMAL/OFFICE, OFFICE/OFFICE and restore NORMAL/NORMAL; include PDA-Agent roundtrip ACK, Agent-Agent receipt, simulated leader failover, reconnect/retry/idempotency, timeout and permission classification without production WMS/Picklist/PRIMARY/call/chat/kick mutations.

As D170 has no Owner PASS and D171 is only queued, do not modify PR612/PR613 code, deploy/test Firestore Rules, create/clear test data, distribute binaries or mutate live resources in this discussion. Stable remains OWNER-GATED.
